title: NotificationCenter as an AsyncSequence
hints: `center.notifications(named:)` is an async sequence of notifications.
Start the listener, wait until it has created its sequence, then post.
jsBridge: `NotificationCenter` is an app-wide event bus, like a global `EventEmitter` or DOM `CustomEvent`s. `notifications(named:)` turns it into an `AsyncSequence` you can `for await` over.

compass.q: `window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('chat.message'))` vs `NotificationCenter.default.post`: which is typed? (Neither, really.)
Stringly-typed `userInfo` dictionaries: how do you make notification payloads type-safe?
NotificationCenter vs delegates vs closures vs `@Observable`: when is a global bus justified?
